text.description_html:
Deltana BDS450U26, Modern Baseboard Door Stop

Not only does this Polished Chrome Contemporary Door Stop look great, it is very versatility. It includes a 3", 1", and 1/2" long section extenders for length customization. Depending on the size needed, you can add the appropriate extender(s) to get just the right length for your door. For commercial or large projects, the Polished Chrome Contemporary Door Stop is great because you only have to have to stock one product to suite whatever size door stop is needed on site. Keep just a few of these on your truck, and you are ready for most any doorstop need. It is easy to install, by screwing onto the baseboard casement or door bottom and will protect your door, wall, and knob / lever sets. It is made of solid brass and includes both gray and white rubber tips for your decor.

These are available in 8 other great finishes: Modern Door Stops

Specifications for the Deltana BDS450U26 Contemporary Baseboard Door Stop:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Finish: Bright Polished Chrome
  • Minimum Length: 3-1/2"
  • Maximum Length: 4-1/2"
  • Diameter: 5/8"
  • Rubber Bumper Tips: White and Gray Tips included
  • Packaged with mounting hardware.
